title: Setting up, and refusing to overwrite
intro: init is the only command that runs before .majordomus/ exists. It writes a policy, four profiles, templates, provider templates and prompt assets, and it never touches state/ — including under --force.

scenarios.title: A repository with no .majordomus/
scenarios.explain: The skeleton is copied in and the two hook lines it needs are printed, together with the command that will verify they were added. init does not install hooks itself.

scenarios.title: A repository that already has one
scenarios.explain: Exit 15 is REFUSED, not an error. Overwriting a policy someone has edited is the kind of silent loss this tool exists to prevent, so it stops and says what to pass if you meant it.

scenarios.title: Rewriting deliberately with --force
scenarios.explain: --force rewrites policy, profiles, templates and provider templates. state/ is still untouched: durable records are never collateral damage of a reinstall.
